W.note: Clean and small with reduced motion collapsed to a static end state, but it has no pause, no graph, and only the spec string as a readout, so the curves are hard to judge.

X.note: Graphs with live progress readouts, a pause control, a reversed return pass and a ease-out reference make each curve legible, though Plant and Snap are both front-loaded ease-outs and the 320 ms spec wraps awkwardly.

Y.note: Press, Release and Settle have clearly different shapes, each card shows a playhead, progress and peak values, the loops return seamlessly, and reduced motion starts paused, with only minor dot overflow past the track on Release.

Z.note: The undershoot anticipation gives a real grip, but the graphs clip at the top, the dots spill past the track, loops hard-reset instead of returning, and reduced motion is ignored.
